intro.zh: 這些遊戲都出自動遊系。先花 30 秒玩一款，喜歡就往下挑一款完整的，最後看看做出它要上哪些課。
intro.en: Every game here was made in our department. Try one for 30 seconds, pick a longer one if you like it, then see which courses teach you to make it.

hint.zh: 點一下就開始，不用安裝
一局就能看到完整玩法
hint.en: One round shows the whole loop

label.zh: 10 分鐘以上 · 看懂我們在做什麼

hint.zh: 玩完接著看課程地圖與實驗室
hint.en: Then explore the curriculum and labs

pitch.zh: 按住光點，穿過系上三間真實實驗室的桌面和地板，碰到器材就回起點。三關三種手感：逐格、運筆、慣性，每過一關解鎖一門系上真的有開的課。
pitch.en: Hold the spark and cross the tables and floors of three real labs in our department. Touch the gear and you restart. Three stages, three feels: frame-by-frame, steady brush, and momentum. Each unlocks a real course.

credit.zh: 原創玩法致敬：電流急急棒（朝日電視台節目單元）。場景為系上實驗室實景照片轉漫畫（沿用《六樓出口》）。
credit.en: An original homage to the TV-show game Irritating Stick (TV Asahi). Scenes are real photos of our labs turned into comics (shared with Sixth-Floor Exit).

pitch.zh: 在設計大樓六樓的循環走廊裡找異常，找錯就重來。走廊、教室、實驗室都是系上真實場景。
pitch.en: Walk the looping 6th-floor corridor of our Design Building and spot what's wrong. Miss an anomaly and you start over. Every room is a real place in our department.

pitch.zh: 清新像素風的大老二，十關茶友旅程，每關換一位牌友和一套花草牌組。用 Unity 做成網頁版。
pitch.en: A cozy pixel-art take on the card game Big Two: ten stages, a new tea-party opponent and flower deck each time. Built in Unity for the web.

pitch.zh: 精準切割的卡牌迷宮：切下食材、組合料理、一路往地窖深處走。
pitch.en: A card-maze about precise cutting: slice ingredients, combine dishes, and cook your way deeper into the cellar.

pitch.zh: 動遊系學生趕畢展的塔防遊戲：需求變更、Bug、當機、評審都變成怪物，守住交件主機撐過十關。玩完就知道畢業專題在拚什麼。
pitch.en: A tower-defense game about finishing your graduation project: scope changes, bugs, crashes and judges all attack the submission server. Survive ten stages and you'll know what our capstone feels like.

credit.zh: 素材授權：BGM 為 CAFOFO（Unity Asset Store 授權）、字型 Cubic 11（OFL）。
credit.en: Assets: BGM by CAFOFO (Unity Asset Store licence), font Cubic 11 (OFL).
